notes.title: Release Notes for 10/30/2023
notes.notes:
A new version of the game is now available with minor changes.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players could erase lines in play mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes for 10/18/2023
notes.notes:
A new version of the game is now available with minor changes.

This version fixes a few issues present in previous versions of the game.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed words incorrectly spelt in the tutorial, in the help menu, and in the settings menu
[*] Reduced the force some speed pads apply to the ball in Sector 2, and a few levels in Sector 1
[/list]

notes.title: Cubenomics NextFest Dev Stream #2
notes.notes:
This event will be a 1 hour live playthrough of [b]Cubenomics: The Puzzle Game[/b] for NextFest. Feel free to ask any questions, and give feedback.

Consider checking out the demo.

Cubenomics is a physics puzzle game, where you draw lines around a cube to create a tracks a ball can ride along. The goal of each puzzle is to unlock the exit by opening all the locks then guiding the ball to the exit.
